verdict.rationale: Make documents that a scenario's webhook URL can be called "from another" scenario to trigger its execution, so one workflow can invoke another as a callable unit. Data stores can also pass data between scenarios. This is an indirect, webhook-based pattern rather than a documented first-class sub-scenario or module-composition feature. Missing for 10: a dedicated sub-workflow/callable-scenario feature, documented input/output contracts and return values to the caller, guidance on reuse and versioning, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can compose reusable sub-workflows or modules that other workflows call

citations.quote: webhooks create a url that you can call from an external app or service, or from another use webhooks to trigger the execution
Data stores are used to store data from scenarios or for transferring data in between individual scenarios or scenario runs.
